jobs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame from a high-end interview video. A confident Russian man about 36 with short dark hair neatly styled, light stubble, warm brown eyes, wearing a deep burgundy knitted polo shirt and a black smartwatch. He sits in a black leather armchair in a dark moody studio, leaning slightly forward, one hand raised in a calm explaining gesture at chest height, looking straight into the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, serious warm expression, NO big smile. Medium shot from the knees up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 14% below the upper edge. Background: almost black with a soft dark-blue gradient light behind him. No microphone. Rich cinematic contrast, real camera frame, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
